ceremony.name: Community member onboarding (wallet and community)
ceremony.choreography: docs/30-onboarding-vetting-ceremonies.md section 3: the criteria, the application, the administrator's decision (the community's own act), the applicant's poll, withdrawal; negatives for a replay, a tampered or unsigned submission, a wrong recipient, an unknown or repeated decision, an outsider's poll and decision, a foreign presentation, a stale clock; the version skew of submit 0.2 against 0.3.
